title: ToolContract
description: A single typed capability exposed to an agent. Semantic name, version tiered, risk classed.

name.description: Semantic name, e.g. scene.inspect. Never a raw host API symbol.

host.description: Host id, e.g. blender, qgis, rhino.

applicableVersions.description: Semver ranges of host versions this capability is valid for.

requiresScope.description: Write/execute tools must be given an explicit target scope; enforced server-side.

supersededBy.description: Tool to suggest when this one is unavailable.
